change_summary: The current guarded wrapper resolves the locked record.candidate_raw_path, validates its canonical destination under this study runs/<same scene>/ tree, creates the planned directory, and validates SOURCE_LOCK_v2. It is the later wrapper lineage for any separately authorized remaining scenes.
first_raw_lineage: The first engineering-gate raw records SOURCE_LOCK_v1 and run-time RELEASE SHA in run_start/status/identity. The v1 wrapper bytes and exact run-time RELEASE bytes are not archived; this lock does not claim the current wrapper executed that first raw.
